step4_backend: Backend testing. Project tests are plain scripts (CI loops `python tests/test_*.py` against Postgres), not pytest, so no install was needed. Ran them with the existing FellowScript .venv against a throwaway Postgres cluster (initdb in the scratchpad, port 55432, schema bootstrapped via db.create_tables exactly as CI does; a scratchpad-only psycopg2 sitecustomize shim redirected db.py's hard-coded 5432 to 55432 so the real local DB on 5432 was never touched; tests' own scratch-DB port guard passed). NEW test: api/tests/test_thread_shared_objects.py, 79 checks, 79 passed, 0 failed. Covers: verse and note share into a thread (stored meta/fallback text server-built, forged title/preview/text/owner/reference ignored, no object key, nothing written to messages, ack, live frame body = fallback line, push body readable with no raw meta/note text); 19 uniform not_allowed denials with nothing stored (other user's private note, reply note, unknown/malformed/missing note id, non-dict/list meta, invalid verse refs, attachment_key on both shared kinds, non-member, forged group_id, suspended sender, unknown/malformed thread); flag matrix (chat_shared_objects off and threads off deny shares, plain text still sends); regression for plain/image/unknown-kind thread sends; thread history clean_shared_note_meta (markup stripped on read, stored row untouched, verse returned); thread note read grant (member reads, sender reads, one-note-only, non-member, other user's path, verse/plain/unknown/malformed/sql-ish ids all identical 404, block pair both directions, left group and rejoined, sender no longer a member, suspended viewer, soft-deleted thread message and restore, note became a reply, ownership moved, editable group note made private, note deleted, threads flag off at read time, unauthenticated); log hygiene (no note text, no ERROR records). FULL BACKEND SUITE: all 173 api/tests/test_*.py scripts run; 171 exit 0 (including every related suite: test_shared_objects 78 checks, test_thread_websocket, test_threads, test_threads_lifecycle, test_thread_delete, test_chat_mentions, test_message_replies, test_shared_foundation*, all green after the change). 2 scripts fail for environment reasons unrelated to this change: test_apns_config_validation.py (needs the real AuthKey_DNZPK26TF2.p8 at the repo root, absent in the worktree) and test_callkit_voip_ring.py (my dummy APNs key file is not a valid PEM; CI generates its own). Neither touches thread/share code. Note: a concurrent session overwrote a shared scratchpad shim mid-run, so ~50 scripts were refused by their port guard (not real failures); those were re-run with a private shim and all passed. Nothing pushed or deployed; scratch Postgres stopped.
